contentKind.instructions: What is the primary content being offered? Classify the content, not whether to approve it.

criteria.software: Runnable tool, application, library, plugin or agent skill
criteria.reading: Book, tutorial, research paper, questionnaire or plain list
criteria.profile: An individual personal homepage or portfolio
criteria.business: Company services, consulting or physical shop

installationMention.instructions: Does the text explicitly include software installation or usage instructions, such as a command, installation path, or host installation menu?

pluginMention.instructions: Does the text explicitly describe the offered package as an extension or plugin for a named host application?

skillMention.instructions: Does the text explicitly describe the offered package as a reusable AI agent skill with SKILL.md or a skills installation directory?
